description: The direct limit of an increasing family of substructures is canonically isomorphic to their union.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.DirectLimit.Equiv_iSup.{v, u_1, u_2, u_3} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {ι : Type v} [Preorder ι]
  [Nonempty ι] [IsDirectedOrder ι] {M : Type u_1} [L.Structure M] (S : ι →o L.Substructure M) :
  L.Equiv
    (FirstOrder.Language.DirectLimit (fun i => ↥(S i)) fun x x_1 h => FirstOrder.Language.Substructure.inclusion ⋯)
    ↥(iSup ⇑S)
